decisions.decision: Creative slot writes: refuse stale (crossed a push within max(150ms, latency+100ms)) or locked writes, hand item back via placeItemBackInInventory; confirm accepted writes instead of setRemoteSlot
decisions.rationale: Creative packets carry no state id; vanilla assumed client state and deleted teammates' items

decisions.decision: Client marks inventoryMenu.lastSlots as seen after every server inventory update
decisions.rationale: Creative screen echoed server pushes back as absolute writes, reverting newer teammate changes

decisions.decision: Resend inventory (broadcastFullState) after any real container close
decisions.rationale: transferState counts slot updates the client dropped for the closed window as delivered

decisions.decision: Middle-click always places a mark while marks are on (replaces pick block); sky aim marks far end of the 512-block ray
decisions.rationale: User asked for marks always/everywhere independent of sneaking

decisions.decision: Mark size interpolates logarithmically between 4 and 256 blocks (diamond radius 2.4->1.2 GUI px, label 0.6->0.45)
decisions.rationale: User asked for ~50% size, bigger near, smaller far, within bounds
